stem:
Priya's mother is buying a new pan for cooking rotis on the stove. She wants the heat to pass quickly from the flame to the food.
Which material should she choose for the base of the pan?

options.text: copper, because it lets heat pass through it easily
wood, because it does not let heat pass through it easily
wool, because it traps air and slows heat transfer
plastic, because it is light and easy to carry

teacher.key_rationale: Cooking needs easy heat flow, so a good conductor is required. Copper is a good conductor of heat, so the base of the pan should be copper (A). Wood, wool and plastic are poor conductors/insulators and would slow heat transfer, so B, C and D are incorrect.
